messages.content: Validate only the single check described. Judge meaning, not exact wording. Return one JSON object with boolean valid and string issue. Reject only when the described check clearly fails.

CHECK: WITHIN-BEAT COHERENCE ONLY.
Reject an ordinary action that transforms an entire solid body into a different material or state without an explicitly established capability. Accept unusual transformations when a relevant capability is established.

ESTABLISHED CAPABILITIES
Tala's touch transmutes stone into water.

CANDIDATE
Tala places her palm against the stone statue, and the statue transforms into water.
